cells.gaps: About 30 municipalities use El Mouhassil (April 2025), with no total of communes given, so the count is a floor. Each commune holds its own database; nothing says it reports to the centre. No plan is stated and nothing is dated inside the twelve months.
cells.note: The decentralisation directorate says El Mouhassil, in use since 2020, now serves about 30 municipalities (MRT-012, April 2025), recording a census of taxpayers in each commune's database (MRT-015, MRT-016): live past its pilot, a count with no total, stage 3. Stage 4 needs more than half of communes on a share or a count with a denominator.
